svg.aria-label: What I build: AI and voice mobile apps, cross-platform Flutter apps, tactile neumorphic UI at 120 FPS, cloud and offline-first systems, and feature-first clean architecture

g.text: Mobile apps that feel native, respond instantly, and scale cleanly.
combined with reactive Drift ORM and SQLite local databases
so the application is always responsive offline.
Decoupled presentation, domain and data layers.
Predictable state management with BLoC / Cubit and Provider
that scales smoothly across complex codebases.
Smooth at 120 FPS • Offline-first by default • Clean, testable architecture • Voice & AI on-device • One codebase, every screen •
